column7: The aws-sdk-go-v2 deserialization error quotes the response body; for GetSecretValue that is the secret value, and awssource.List returned the error text unchanged. Fixed by reporting only the HTTP status for errors that carry the response (sdkSafeError), as azuresource.statusOnlyError does. Found by FuzzAWSSourceHostileEndpoint (VALUE-LEAK oracle), fuzz-corpus KFZ-2026-191
